scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mahjong/server" "npm run dev -w @mahjong/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @mahjong/server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mahjong/server && npm run build -w @mahjong/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @mahjong/server
